findings.description: The bucket is explicitly noted and configured to be publicly accessible (no ACL restricting to private, no public access block), exposing potentially sensitive data (a customer master file is stored in it) to the internet.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects stored in this bucket, including the customer master file, are not encrypted at rest.
Versioning is not enabled, meaning objects can be overwritten or deleted without recovery, increasing risk in combination with public access and lack of encryption.

findings.issue_category: sensitive data in public unencrypted bucket
findings.description: A customer master spreadsheet (customer-master.xlsx), likely containing sensitive PII, is uploaded to the aws_s3_bucket.data bucket which is public and unencrypted, resulting in direct exposure of sensitive data.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket, so financial data stored here is not encrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket, leaving stored operations data unencrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket, leaving stored data science data unencrypted at rest.
